import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

    H=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(np.array(src,np.float32)*5,np.array(dst,np.float32)*5)
    return cv2.warpPerspective(ref,H,(1280,720),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REPLICATE)


def recovered_tip(ref,t,tip):
    # Source-frame 36 gives a completely visible box at a matching angle.
    # Warp its three real surfaces, including the original beveled texture.
    back,left,outer,bottom=tip[0],None,tip[2],tip[3]
    left=tip[0]+(tip[2]-tip[1])
    A=np.array([143+(t-36)*.16,94.4],float)
    AB=np.array([143.3+(t-36)*.11,87.7],float)
    Cb=tip[0];Db=tip[1];C=left;D=outer;B=bottom
    faces=[
       ([[166,35.6],[168.4,40.4],[143,94.4],[143.3,87.7]], [Cb,C,A,AB], 'side'),
       ([[168.4,40.4],[176.6,43.6],[152.5,102],[143,94.4]],[C,D,B,A], 'front'),
       ([[166,35.6],[174.2,39.2],[176.6,43.6],[168.4,40.4]],[Cb,Db,D,C], 'cap')]
    im=np.zeros((720,1280,3),float)
    for src,dst,kind in faces:
        tx=warp_face(ref,src,dst).astype(float)
        if kind=='side':
            tx*=1+min(.30,max(0,t-36)*.022)
        if kind=='cap':
            tx*=1-min(.22,max(0,t-36)*.017)
        mask=polygon_mask(dst,144,256,5)
        mm=cv2.resize(mask,(1280,720),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        im=im*(1-mm[:,:,None])+tx*mm[:,:,None]
    return cv2.resize(im,(256,144),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)


def shadow_field(a,t):
    \"\"\"Use the unaffected second domino's floor shadow for the third.

    Its phase is nine frames earlier. Ratios (not colors) are transferred so
    that the right-hand floor retains its own original lighting and texture.
    \"\"\"
    # A clean local plane under domino two, estimated across its narrow shadow.
    src=a[max(0,t-9)].astype(float)
    Y,X=np.mgrid[:144,:256]
    factor=np.ones((144,256),float)
    for y in range(94,144):
        anchors=np.array([85,90,94,127,133,139])
        v=np.array([np.median(a[0,y,x-1:x+2,1]) for x in anchors])
        g=PchipInterpolator(anchors,v)(np.arange(96,177))
        # Extrapolation far from the local reference isn't needed.
        g=np.maximum(70,g)
        row=src[y,96:177]
        floor=(row[:,1]-row[:,0]>12)&(row[:,1]-row[:,2]>30)
        rat=np.clip(row[:,1]/g,.36,1)
        rat[~floor]=1
        factor[y,137:218]=rat
    factor=gaussian_filter(factor,.75)
    # Never transfer neighboring domino one's shadow far into the right floor.
    spatial=np.clip((X-166)/7,0,1)*np.clip((144-Y)/3,0,1)
    phase=np.clip((t-30)/7,0,1)
    return 1-(1-factor)*spatial*phase


def generate():
    a=np.load(ROOT/'source_pixels.npz')['rgb']
    assert a.shape==(96,144,256,3)
    bg=clean_plate(a)
    cap=cv2.VideoCapture(str(ROOT/'source_video.mp4'))
    cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES,36)
    ok,br=cap.read();cap.release()
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError('Cannot read the reference source surface')
    ref=br[:,:,::-1].copy()
    out=[]
    Y,X=np.mgrid[:144,:256]
    for t in range(96):
        factual=a[t].astype(float)
        removal,tip=right_mask(t)
        # The source's floor noise and background remain untouched outside the
        # causal edit. The cleared region contains the original lit green plane.
        cleared=bg.copy()
        if t>=31:
            shade=shadow_field(a,t)
            # Shadow lighting is primarily multiplicative, with a small ambient
            # green contribution matching the source contact shadows.
            cleared*=shade[:,:,None]
        im=factual*(1-removal[:,:,None])+cleared*removal[:,:,None]
        if 37<=t<=46:
            rebuilt=recovered_tip(ref,t,tip)
            # The fourth was in front of the very end of domino three. Replace
            # those occluded pixels with the surviving third's own real texture.
            four_left={37:179,38:182.3,39:186.3,40:189.3,41:193,42:196,
                       43:200,44:204,45:209,46:215}[t]
            fx=four_left-(Y-40)*.065
            cm=np.clip(X-fx+1,0,1)
            # Full exterior silhouette of the end, before contact removal.
            pts=[tip[0],tip[1],tip[2],tip[3],
                 [143+(t-36)*.16,94.4],[143.3+(t-36)*.11,87.7]]
            cm*=polygon_mask(pts)
            cm*=np.clip((tip[2,1]+.2-Y)*3,0,1)
            cm*=np.clip(rebuilt.max(axis=2)/25,0,1)
            im=im*(1-cm[:,:,None])+rebuilt*cm[:,:,None]
        # Feather only the shadow-cleaning seam, never any solid's silhouette.
        if t<34:
            feather=np.clip((X-169)/3,0,1)
            low=(Y>=103)
            im[low]=factual[low]*(1-feather[low,None])+cleared[low]*feather[low,None]
        out.append(np.clip(np.rint(im),0,255).astype(np.uint8))
    frames=np.stack(out)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    np.savez_compressed(ROOT/'edited_rgb.npz',rgb=frames)
    print('Saved',frames.shape,frames.dtype)

if __name__=='__main__': generate()
